headline: 149 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Second Flat Fire in OR, threatening 2,859 structures.

active_threats.name: Second Flat
active_threats.narrative: The Second Flat Fire in Harney County, OR has burned 105,983 acres and is 18% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **2,859 structures threatened**. 292 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 28 mph, sustained near 18) with humidity as low as 14%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind (N) is not currently aligned toward Hines city, the nearest community of size, 18 miles away.

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over OR, WA: Bend city, Kennewick city, Pasco city, Redmond city, and Walla Walla city and 12 other communities sit under an active Red Flag Warning or Watch and SPC's **Extreme** fire-weather category and NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (day 1). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 23% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
